description: This file defines the ProxyList class used for managing a list of proxy servers, including functions for setting, modifying, and serializing proxy configurations, as well as handling proxy fallback and retry logic.

classes.name: ProxyList
classes.description: A class that manages a list of proxy servers, supporting operations like setting, adding, removing, and serializing proxies, as well as handling fallback and retry logic.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Initializes the proxy list from a string containing one or more proxy servers.

methods.name: SetSingleProxyServer
methods.description: Sets the proxy list to a single specified proxy server.

methods.name: AddProxyServer
methods.description: Appends a proxy server to the end of the proxy list.

methods.name: DeprioritizeBadProxies
methods.description: Moves cached bad proxies to the end of the fallback list to deprioritize them.

methods.name: RemoveProxiesWithoutScheme
methods.description: Removes proxies that do not match specified schemes.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the proxy list is empty.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of proxies in the list.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if this proxy list is equal to another.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the first proxy server in the list.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Returns all proxy servers in the list.

methods.name: SetFromPacString
methods.description: Parses a PAC string to set the proxy list.

methods.name: ToPacString
methods.description: Returns a PAC-style string representing the proxy list.

methods.name: ToValue
methods.description: Serializes the proxy list into a base::Value.

methods.name: Fallback
methods.description: Marks the current proxy as bad and attempts fallback to the next proxy.

methods.name: UpdateRetryInfoOnFallback
methods.description: Updates retry info for proxies after fallback.

methods.name: AddProxyToRetryList
methods.description: Marks a specific proxy as bad for retry purposes.
